title: Dunyo o'ynagan o'yin muallifi 12 yil mualliflik haqi olmadi...

scenes.text: 1984 yil iyunida Moskvadagi dasturchi Aleksey Pajitnov ish kompyuterida bir o'yin yozdi.
Tushayotgan shakllardan to'liq qator yig'ilsa, qator yo'qoladi. U o'yinni Tetris deb atadi.
O'yin SSSRda tez tarqaldi, keyin chet elga chiqdi. Lekin huquqlar davlatga tegishli edi.
1989 yilda Tetris Game Boy bilan birga sotila boshladi. Pajitnov esa mualliflik haqi olmadi.
Faqat 1996 yilda, taxminan 12 yildan keyin, u Henk Rodjers bilan The Tetris Company'ni tuzdi va o'z o'yinidan mualliflik haqi ola boshladi.

description:
Aleksey Pajitnov Tetrisni 1984 yil iyunida Moskvada, SSSR Fanlar akademiyasining hisoblash markazida yaratgan. Huquqlar sovet davlatiga tegishli bo'lgani uchun u uzoq yil mualliflik haqi olmagan. 1996 yilda Henk Rodjers bilan The Tetris Company'ni tuzgach, daromad ola boshlagan.

Siz Tetris o'ynaganmisiz? Izohda yozing.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-23 (web-search summaries; pages did not open). TRUE: created June 1984 in Moscow at the Soviet Academy of Sciences computing centre; Soviet state (Elorg) held the rights; Game Boy bundle 1989; Pajitnov and Henk Rogers formed The Tetris Company in 1996; he received no royalties before. SOFTENED: 'pul olmadi' changed to 'mualliflik haqi olmadi' (he had salaries and other work, only royalties are documented as absent) and '12 yil' to 'taxminan 12 yil' (Wikipedia gives 1995 for the rights reverting, the company was formed 1996). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tetris ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexey_Pajitnov ; https://www.biography.com/movies-tv/a43498846/tetris-creator-alexey-pajitnov-received-no-royalties-initially ; https://tetris.com/bios ; https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2009/06/08/tetris-still-cool-25-years-on-a51909
